description: Scientists are developing biomimicry-inspired robots to explore enormous lava tubes beneath Mars. The underground caves could preserve signs of life and potentially shelter future human explorers from harsh Martian radiation.
title: Scientists Develop Swarm Robots to Explore Hidden Lava Tubes on Mars

description: Ethereum liquid staking protocol Kelp DAO has completed the restoration of its rsETH token after suffering a $293 million exploit linked to North Korea’s Lazarus Group. The recovery effort involved multiple DeFi protocols under the “DeFi United” initiative to rebuild rsETH backing and restore cross-chain operations.
title: Kelp DAO Completes Recovery of Restaked Ether Token Following Major Hack

description: Written and directed by Denis Villeneuve, Dune Part Two is an American action-adventure film that is now available to stream on Netflix.
title: Dune Part Two Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This American Action-Adventure Masterpiece

description: Office Romance follows a strict CEO who secretly falls for a witty lawyer working at her company.
title: Office Romance OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Jennifer Lopez’s Workplace Rom-Com Online?

description: A new leak suggests that the iQOO 16 could launch with an 8,500mAh battery and Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. The handset is also tipped to feature a 2K flat display built on a new custom substrate and support an ultra-high refresh rate. Previous reports indicate that the phone may use an upgraded cooling system, an in-house performance chip, and a periscope telephoto camera. The iQOO 16 has reportedly appeared on the IMEI database and could launch in India following its China debut.
title: iQOO 16 Tipped With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC, 2K 'Ultra-High' Refresh Rate Display

description: Oppo Find X10 is expected to be months away from launch, but a new leak reveals the possible specifications of the phone. It is said to feature a 6.59-inch 1.5K LTPO display with up to 165Hz refresh rate. The upcoming phone is said to come with an 8,000mAh battery, marking an upgrade over the Oppo Find X9, which has a 7,025mAh cell.
title: Oppo Find X10 Tipped to Feature 165Hz Refresh Rate Display, 8,000mAh Battery

description: Xiaomi 17T Pro will be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. Apart from this, the tech firm has also revealed that the smartphone will be backed by a 7,000mAh silicon carbon battery. The handset is claimed to provide up to 9.5 hours of continuous video recording on a single charge. The Xiaomi 17T Pro will be the first phone in the lineup to feature a MediaTek chipset, as other Xiaomi 17 series phones are powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro Confirmed to Feature a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chipset as Company Reveals Key Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 renders have surfaced online, revealing the design of the rumoured smartphone. Additionally, the full list of the specifications and features of the handset has been leaked. The phone is shown to sport a pill-shaped rear camera module, featuring three camera lenses, along with an LED flash. On the front, it is expected to feature a hole-punch display cutout, which might house the selfie camera. The Samsung branding appears at the bottom of the flat rear panel. The Galaxy A27 could be offered in Black, Blue, and Light Pink colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 Design Spotted in Leaked Renders as Key Specifications Surface Online

description: Crypto exchange OKX has launched Exchange OS, a new platform built on its Ethereum Layer 2 network X Layer that allows users to create spot perpetuals and outcomes markets. The company said the platform will support shared liquidity, custom compliance frameworks, and high-speed on-chain trading infrastructure.
title: OKX Introduces Exchange OS to Support User-Created Crypto Trading Markets

description: Sureshanteyum Sumalathayudeyum Hrudayahariyaya Pranayakadha is a Malayalam romance drama film that is finally out on OTT. It is currently streaming on Amazon Prime Video.
title: Sureshanteyum Sumalathayudeyum Hrudayahariyaya Pranayakadha Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream it Online

description: Mermaid follows a troubled man who discovers and protects an injured mermaid from people trying to exploit her.
title: Mermaid (2026) OTT Release Date: Where to Watch the Dark Comedy Film Online

description: Lava Shark 2 5G has been launched in India, the Noida-based smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. The new handset will go on sale in the country on June 10. It is offered in two colour options, namely Arya Blue and Sonar Gold, and a single 4GB + 64GB RAM and storage configuration. The Lava Shark 2 5G is a dual SIM smartphone that runs on vanilla Android 16. It is equipped with a 6.75-inch HD+ LCD touchscreen, delivering up to 120Hz of refresh rate. The Lava Shark 2 5G is powered by an octa core Unisoc T8200 chipset.
title: Lava Shark 2 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: IO Interactive's James Bond action-adventure title, 007 First Light, is almost here. The game launches on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on May 27. Early access begins on May 26 for users who pre-ordered the game. Here's everything you need to know about 007 First Light ahead of launch.
title: 007 First Light Launch: Release Timings, Price and Everything You Need to Know

description: Oppo started the sale of Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s in India. Both models are currently available for purchase in the country via the Oppo India website, retail partners, Amazon and Flipkart. The Ultra model runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, while the Find X9s has a MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset under the hood. They have Hasselblad-powered cameras and run on ColorOS 16.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s Now on Sale in India: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers

description: Ever since Google restructured its Gemini plans to a compute-based usage system, it has struggled to provide users of its agentic coding platform, Antigravity, with enough tokens. The Mountain View-based tech giant, last week, announced a shift from the message-based usage to one that measures the number of tokens exhausted. Once the new system was rolled out, users began complaining about hitting rate limits on Antigravity very quickly.
title: Google Introduces Gemini 3.5 Flash Low to Help Antigravity Users Maximise Usage

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will be launched in India on June 18, according to a report. The new smartphone is said to launch in the country along with the new Redmi 17 5G. This comes shortly after the tech firm began teasing the launch of the Redmi Turbo 5 in India. However, the exact launch for the remain under wraps. In terms of specifications and features, the handset is said to be similar to its Chinese counterpart. The Redmi Turbo 5 is expected to sport a 6.59-inch (1,268×2,756 pixels) AMOLED display, offering up to 120Hz of refresh rate.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Launch Date Tipped; Could Arrive Along With the Redmi 17 5G

description: Infinix Hot 70 has been launched in select global markets. It runs on a MediaTek Helio G100 Ultimate chipset and has a 6,000mAh battery. The Infinix Hot 70 is released in Dive Blue, Green Texture, Night Pulse, Thermo Orange, Quiet Violet, and Silver Dancer colours. It is offered in 4GB, 6GB and 8GB RAM options alongside 128GB and 256GB storage configurations. It has an IP65-rated build for dust and water resistance.
title: Infinix Hot 70 Announced With MediaTek Helio G100 Ultimate Chipset, 6,000mAh Battery

description: A new leak has revealed key details about a Vivo X500 Pro series smartphone, which could launch as the Vivo X500 Pro or Vivo X500 Pro Mini. The handset is said to feature a 50-megapixel main camera with a 1/1.28-inch LOFIC sensor, a 50-megapixel ultra-wide camera, and a 64-megapixel periscope telephoto camera using Sony's IMX06H sensor. It may also use a 2nm MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series chipset. Previous reports suggest a 6.37-inch LTPO display and a battery exceeding 7,000mAh.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Camera Specifications Leak; Tipped to Feature MediaTek Dimensity 9600 SoC

description: Honor 600e has been launched in select global markets as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s N-series. The company unveiled the handset silently after the Honor 600 and Honor 600 Pro were launched in China. The new Honor 600e is currently available for purchase in Peru via the Honor online store. The handset is offered in three colour options, dubbed Desert Gold, Velvet Gray, and Vital Green. The phone is powered by an octa core MediaTek 7100 chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 512GB of onboard storage.
title: Honor 600e Launched With 108-Megapixel Rear Camera, 6520mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Varun Dhawan’s romantic comedy Hai Jawani To Ishq Hona Hai is set to hit theatres on June 5, 2026, with romance, drama, and comedy at its core.
title: Hai Jawani To Ishq Hona Hai OTT Release Reportedly Revealed Online: What You Need to Know

description: Vivo has confirmed that its first over-ear wireless ANC headphones will launch in China on May 29 alongside the Vivo S60 series and Vivo TWS 5e earbuds. The headphones will be available in Cloud White and Breeze Purple colours, weigh around 238g, support active noise cancellation, and offer triple-device connectivity across phones, tablets, and PCs. Vivo has already opened reservations in China. The company has also teased the TWS 5e, which offers up to 55dB hybrid adaptive ANC and up to 55 hours of battery life.
title: Vivo Teases First Over-Ear ANC Headphones Ahead of May 29 Launch

description: Bitcoin traded near $76,800 on Tuesday as continued ETF outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty kept crypto market sentiment cautious. Analysts said easing oil prices and stabilising support levels helped limit downside pressure, though investors remain defensive ahead of upcoming US inflation and Federal Reserve triggers.
title: Bitcoin Struggles Near $76,800 as ETF Outflows Continue to Pressure Markets

description: Realme P4s 5G will be launched in India in June, a tipster claims. The smartphone was reportedly spotted with the model number RMX5125. The leaker has also shared the RAM and storage configurations of the rumoured handset, along with its colour options. The phone is expected to arrive in the country in two colour options, dubbed Brown and Green. Moreover, the purported Realme P4s 5G will reportedly be available for purchase in India in four RAM and storage configurations, with the top-of-the-line model featuring 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage.
title: Realme P4s 5G India Launch Timeline Tipped Along With Storage Variants, Colourways

description: Insta360's unannounced Luna Ultra gimbal camera has appeared in a pre-order listing from German retailer Foto Erhardt. Customers can reserve the device with a EUR 50 (roughly Rs. 5,500) deposit that will count toward the final purchase price. The listing reveals key specifications, including a 1-inch sensor, Leica Summicron lens, 8K video recording, 4K capture at up to 120fps, a triple AI chip with Deep Track, and a detachable touchscreen remote. The camera also supports Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, USB Type-C, and up to four hours of battery life.
title: Insta360 Luna Ultra Pre-Orders Open, Listed With 8K Video and Leica Lens Ahead of Launch

description: After the 6GHz spectrum opening, TP-Link India started the local production of Wi-Fi 7 hardware in India. The company, which is part of TP-Link Systems, will begin manufacturing with the Omada EAP770 enterprise access point.  The Omada EAP770 will be a flagship product. It is a tri-band Wi-Fi 7 ceiling-mount enterprise access point designed for high-density deployments. It integrates with TP-Link's Omada Software Defined Networking (SDN) platform.
title: TP-Link India Starts Local Manufacturing of Wi-Fi 7 Products Following 6GHz Spectrum Delicensing

description: Oppo A6c has been launched in India as the smartphone maker’s latest addition to its A series. Positioned as a budget handset, the new Oppo A6c is currently on sale in the country via the Oppo India online store. The handset is offered in two colour options, dubbed Feather White and Stone Brown. It is powered by an octa core Unisoc T7250 chipset, along with a Mali-G57 GPU, 4GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 onboard storage. The smartphone is backed by a 7,000mAh battery with support for 15W wired charging.
title: Oppo A6c Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Honor has introduced the Watch 6 Plus in China alongside the Honor 600 series. The smartwatch features a 1.46-inch AMOLED display with up to 3,000 nits brightness, Bluetooth calling, GNSS navigation, AI-assisted fitness coaching, and comprehensive health monitoring tools. It runs MagicOS and supports Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS devices. The wearable houses a 1,000mAh battery that is rated for up to 35 days of usage. Prices start at CNY 1,299 (roughly Rs. 18,300), and sales begin in China on May 29.
title: Honor Watch 6 Plus Launched With 1.46-Inch AMOLED Display, Up to 35 Days Battery Life

description: Vivo S60 and Vivo S60 Vitality Edition's key specifications and features have surfaced online. Both handsets will reportedly be equipped with a 6.59-inch flat display, offering 1260p resolution. Moreover, the two smartphones are said to ship with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. While the Vivo S60 will reportedly be powered by an octa core Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset from Qualcomm, the Vitality Edition is said to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 7500 SoC. For optics, the Vivo S60 is said to carry a triple rear camera system, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Vivo S60, Vivo S60 Vitality Edition Full List of Specifications, Features Tipped Days Ahead of Launch

description: Honor 600 series launched in the Chinese market with three models. The Honor 600 Pro runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 8550 Elite chip, while the Honor 600 Vitality Edition and Honor 600 Super Edition have a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset under the hood. The Honor 600 Super Edition has an 8,600mAh battery. The trio offers MagicOS 10 based on Android 16 and features a 6.57-inch AMOLED display. They have 50-megapixel front-facing cameras.
title: Honor 600 Pro With Dimensity 8550 Elite SoC Launched Alongside Honor 600: Price, Specifications

description: At its core, the Kojima edition laptop is an ROG Flow device — the same detachable tablet/notebook that balances portability and power. But everywhere you look, Kojima Productions' stamp on its design is unmistakable: from its black and gold colour scheme and the details on the CNC-milled aluminium and carbon fibre chassis, to the Kojima Productions typeface and the custom carrying case.
title: Asus ROG Flow Z13-KJP Review: For Ludens Who Care
